en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly spa town nestled in a forested valley. Dense late‑19th‑century and early‑20th‑century buildings with steep metal roofs fill the foreground, while large hotels, villas, and sanatorium‑like structures line the slopes in the middle distance. A distinctive white villa with a tower stands to the right against the wooded hillside. In the far background, forested hills encircle the town. The image has no visible caption or border text on its front side.
